segments.title: How deep is the DEEPEST spot in the ocean?
segments.say: How deep is the deepest spot in the ocean? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: About 11 KILOMETERS!
segments.say: About eleven kilometers! Ten thousand nine hundred thirty five meters.

segments.title: It's the Challenger Deep
segments.say: It's the Challenger Deep, in the Mariana Trench.

segments.title: Average ocean: 3.7 km
segments.say: The average ocean is only about three point seven kilometers deep.
